content.study: Related party transactions. Related party is s. 2(76). Disclosure is s. 184. Approval of specified contracts is s. 188, with audit-committee approval under s. 177 where that committee exists. The section applies only to the persons, companies, and transactions it names. A filing, approval, or penalty arises only where the section or a rule under it says so. It does not create a power that is reserved to another section or to the Tribunal. Not a verified closure.

sections.heading: Explanation
sections.body: Identify the party, the contract type, ordinary-course and arm's length status, thresholds, and the voting exclusion. Listed companies have additional LODR rules. A non-compliant contract is voidable and may require indemnity.
